notes: All 24 callees log their tag, the 13 with an argument also EAX (and EDX for the two pool allocators and 0xa78bc). 0xa46cc returns the name plus 0x60000, where the widget index byte +0x10 is random; 0x50770 returns a per-case value; the others return EAX plus a constant. Cases vary the war won/lost words, target choice, target window and input flags and the lookup count.
